text: I sense a quiet anticipation in this modern place. The glass-walled meeting room hints at preparation and dialogue, its emptiness a canvas for ideas yet to form. Nearby, vibrant colors leap from the research and development exhibit. The space feels alive with potential and curiosity, nudging me to reflect on human advancement and our constant urge to explore new knowledge. I feel alert, inquisitive, and quietly inspired to participate in the evolving story of progress.
